about.title: Newport Beach Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Coast Highway carries a lot of Newport Beach's daily life, and so do Jamboree Road and MacArthur Boulevard. Those same corridors show up again and again in public collision records. In 2025, the most recent final year on file, the city logged 419 injury collisions, 583 people hurt, and two traffic deaths. Reports cluster on Saturday evenings, roughly 5 p.m. to 7 p.m., the busiest window in the data. If one of those numbers now describes you, the paperwork can feel louder than the injury itself. LawProactive exists to quiet that noise. We are not a law firm. We are a free service that pairs you with an independent Orange County attorney who handles car accident claims on contingency, meaning nothing is owed unless money is recovered. Before anything else, keep what you have: photos, the police report number, the names of anyone who stopped, and every medical bill. And when the other driver's insurer calls asking for a recorded statement, it is fine to say you would rather speak with a lawyer first.

whyChoose.title: Why Newport Beach Drivers Reach Out to LawProactive

items.title: The clock in California is real
items.desc: Most car accident claims here must be filed within two years, but if a city, county, or state vehicle was involved, a government claim can be due in as little as six months. An attorney can pin down which deadline applies to you before it slips.

items.title: Partial blame does not close the door
items.desc: California follows pure comparative fault, so even if you shared some responsibility for a crash on MacArthur Boulevard, you can still pursue a claim reduced by your percentage. That is a detail insurers rarely volunteer.

items.title: No fee unless there is a recovery
items.desc: The independent attorneys in our network work on contingency, and California places no cap on non-economic damages like pain and loss of enjoyment in a standard car accident case. Our connection service costs you nothing.

items.question: My crash was on Coast Highway (SR-1). Does that change anything about my claim?
items.answer: Coast Highway through Newport Beach is a state route, so Caltrans and the city may both have a role depending on where and how the collision happened. If a roadway condition or a public vehicle contributed, a government claim may need to be filed within six months rather than two years. An attorney can sort out which agencies, if any, are involved and what deadlines follow.

items.question: The other driver's insurance adjuster wants a recorded statement. Should I give one?
items.answer: You are not required to give the other side a recorded statement, and it is generally wise to hold off. Adjusters are trained to ask questions that can shrink your claim later, especially while you are still learning the extent of your injuries. Let an attorney handle those conversations, and keep your own notes and photos in the meantime.

items.question: What does LawProactive actually do, and what does it cost?
items.answer: LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm. You tell us about your Newport Beach car accident, and we match you with an independent attorney in our network who handles these claims in Orange County. That attorney works on contingency, so there is no fee unless money is recovered for you.
